subtitle: Lesson 29 · RL Environments & Infrastructure

steps.label: reset()
steps.sub: starts an episode, returns the first observation

steps.label: Repeat until done
steps.sub: then reset() again for the next episode

code:
import gymnasium as gym

env = gym.make("CartPole-v1")
observation, info = env.reset(seed=42)

for _ in range(1000):
    action = env.action_space.sample()
    observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step(action)

    if terminated or truncated:
        observation, info = env.reset()

env.close()
caption: Same loop for any Gymnasium environment, custom or built-in

steps.label: terminated
steps.sub: episode ended by the environment's own dynamics

steps.label: truncated

steps.label: info
